paper_title: Attention to Trajectory: Trajectory-Aware Open-Vocabulary Tracking
venue: ICCV2025pp14390-14398, official CVF proceedings inspected through existing proxy
official_binding: Official CVF abstract explicitly promises release at this exact repository
license: Complete pinned tree has only masa/LICENSE, not a root or TraCLIP license; do not assume it covers omitted classifier sources. No upstream source copied or executed
core_source_unavailable: No models tree at any path in complete untruncated pinned repository, including masa/masa/models
paper_read_scope: Abstract/intro, methods3.1-3.5 and setup4.1; paper metrics are existing public literature, not our TAO run. Remaining experiment analysis/supplement not fully read
original_task: Open-vocabulary trajectory association and final text-vocabulary-assisted classification, not vocabulary-free category discovery
training_entry: Frozen CLIP ViTL14, trainable TraCLIP fusion with optimizerAdam; labels passed to model for training. InspectedLVISscript contrastive/fiveepochs; actual loss body missing so reproduction unestablished
evaluation_entry: eval_only still builds Train and validation loaders, passes labels alongside visual inputs, then top1 and pertrack JSON. Missing classifier/data source prevents proving whether labels influence inference or how track sampling behaves
model_inputs: Paper association uses previous trajectory visual/category banks; final TraCLIP takes complete trajectory clips and base+novel category names/attribute descriptions. Actual entry supplies train/test class-name files
model_outputs: Final named category/score for a whole track, broadcast by transfer utility to every detection in that track; not a versioned causal anonymous category stream
losses: Paper frozen-CLIP contrastive fusion training; unread missing actual TraCLIP loss/model implementation is not filled in from paper/chat
causal_or_noncausal: Paper previous-frame association bank is potentially causal. Complete-trajectory final classification and retroactive pertrack output are not first-frame prefix causal. No actual future-mutation test performed
evaluation: PublicOV-TAO TETA/LocA/AssA/ClsA, not our category discovery H/CT; inspected auxiliary accuracy ignores missing prediction/reference joins and optional filtered IDs, so does not establish our fixed denominator
static_findings_not_executed_failures: Complete pinned source lacks core model/data/association modules; do not call this a complete or executed reproduction
Actual entry passes evaluation labels to missing model; neither leakage nor purity proven without that source
Public converter contains historical Test-path defaults, but was only read as source, never executed and no referenced asset opened
Class-name/attribute files not fetched, novel vocabulary not instantiated, no TAO annotations/data/weights/caches read
what_to_borrow: Only past-visible visual trajectory aggregation and physical association history as independently controlled hypotheses
what_not_to_borrow: Novel names/attribute prompts, complete-track confidence sampling or final-category retroactive writes as causal, unread model inferred from chat or filtered accuracy as fair coverage
